description:
TRIGGER: A user copies any of three examples from pkix-chain/README.md and tries to compile them.

ISSUE 1 (line 22): `TrustAnchor::from_der(root_der)?` — TrustAnchor has no `from_der` constructor. Available constructors per pkix-path/src/lib.rs are `new(subject, spki, name_constraints)`, `from_cert(Certificate)`, and `From<&Certificate>` / `From<Certificate>`. `from_der` is not a method on TrustAnchor. A user copying this snippet hits 'no associated function from_der' immediately.

ISSUE 2 (line 65): `let result = verify_chain(&chain, &anchors, &policy, &my_verifier, &NoRevocation)?;` — only five arguments. The current verify_chain signature (line 384) takes SIX:

    pub fn verify_chain<V, R, A>(
        chain: &[Certificate],
        anchors: &[TrustAnchor],
        policy: &ValidationPolicy,
        verifier: &V,
        revocation: &R,
        aia: &A,    // <-- 6th argument added in PKIX-zkjb.7
    ) -> ...

The 6th `aia` argument was added in PKIX-zkjb.7 (commit 50e43963 wired AIA into Verifier::verify_one) and the README was not updated. A user copying this hits 'this function takes 6 arguments but 5 were supplied'.

ISSUE 3 (lines 121-122): 'The workspace does not yet ship a BasicTlsClientProfile; see the follow-up bead for the missing profile.' — but BasicTlsClientProfile WAS shipped in commit a792545c (PKIX-fmtv.11.2.x). pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:305 defines it.

The README is the first thing a new user reads. Broken examples in the README turn into 'pkix-chain doesn't even compile its own docs' GitHub issues. The doc tests inside src/lib.rs do compile (cargo test --doc passes), but README.md is not run through any compiler — so these regressions slip through.

FIX: (a) regenerate README examples from working source; (b) consider extracting README's Rust blocks into compile-tested doctests (e.g. via doc_comment::doctest! or a build.rs that asserts they match a known-good doctest); (c) at minimum, add a CI step that does `cargo test --doc` AND lints README for code blocks via `mdtest` / `rustdoc --test`.
title: README.md examples are broken: TrustAnchor::from_der does not exist; verify_chain signature changed
